entries.heading: BEST UTILIZATION OF BIOLOGICAL APPLICATIONS
ancestors: TITLE VII—RESEARCH, EXTENSION, AND RELATED MATTERS
Subtitle B—Food, Agriculture, Conservation, and Trade Act of 1990
entries.text:
SEC. 7201. BEST UTILIZATION OF BIOLOGICAL APPLICATIONS.

    Section 1624 of the Food, Agriculture, Conservation, and Trade Act 
of 1990 (7 U.S.C. 5814) is amended in the first sentence by striking 
``2018'' and inserting ``2023''.
